Loss report: gitea -> concourse
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.schedule: time resource (a window time resource has no version until its first window passes, so a person who starts the job before then finds no input; run fly check-resource -r <pipeline>/schedule --from time:2000-01-01T00:00:00Z once after set-pipeline (initial_version: true is not written because it starts the job at once, outside the window))
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.schedule: time resource (a window time resource has no version until its first window passes, so a person who starts the job before then finds no input; run fly check-resource -r <pipeline>/schedule-2 --from time:2000-01-01T00:00:00Z once after set-pipeline (initial_version: true is not written because it starts the job at once, outside the window))
